streaming.name: Live stream
streaming.intro: Set the origin of your live stream so the storefront can preconnect for faster playback. The full stream URL is configured per page in the Coming soon section.

stream_url.label: Stream URL
stream_url.info: Paste an HLS playlist (.m3u8) or an MP4/WebM file URL. HLS is recommended for live cameras.

poster_image.label: Fallback image
poster_image.info: Shown before the stream loads, on slow networks, and when reduced motion is enabled.

launch_date.label: Launch date
launch_date.info: ISO format, e.g. 2026-06-01T12:00:00Z. Leave empty to hide the countdown.

featured_collection.label: Featured collection
featured_collection.info: Products from this collection populate the boutique. Leave empty to use the entire catalog. Upload 3D models per product in the product's Media gallery to render them as walk-around objects.

skybox_image.label: Skybox / environment map (optional)
skybox_image.info: An equirectangular HDR-style image used as both the visible background and image-based lighting.

environment_glb_url.paragraph: Load your own interior or showroom as a single glTF/GLB file. Export from Blender with Y-up, origin at floor level, and scale in meters so it lines up with pedestals (~1 m tall).
environment_glb_url.label: Environment GLB URL
environment_glb_url.info: Paste a direct HTTPS link to a .glb file. Upload via Shopify admin → Content → Files, or add the file to your theme’s assets folder and use the asset URL (for example from the theme code editor).

hide_procedural_room.label: Hide the default cylinder room
hide_procedural_room.info: Turn on when your GLB includes its own floor and walls so they are not duplicated. Leave off to stack your model on top of the built-in room (for props or partial sets).

enable_shadows.label: Enable real-time shadows
enable_shadows.info: Improves visual fidelity at a measurable performance cost.
